name: Laxman Nepal Tool Logo Theme Plate
description: Reusable visual identity rules for generating animated tool icons from a tool name and category.

design_language.depth: soft layered depth with restrained glass highlights
design_language.background: category-aware gradient or translucent glass field
design_language.icon_rule: one clear primary symbol, minimal detail, recognizable at 24px
design_language.text_rule: never place the full tool name inside the icon unless explicitly requested
design_language.accessibility: high contrast symbol, distinguishable silhouette, reduced-motion fallback

image-tools.label: Image Tools
image-tools.motion: gentle image-frame reveal with subtle sparkle sweep

video-tools.label: Video Tools
video-tools.motion: soft play-button pulse followed by a short timeline sweep

ai-tools.label: AI Tools
ai-tools.motion: small orbital sparkle motion with a soft intelligent glow

youtube-tools.label: YouTube Tools
youtube-tools.motion: play symbol scales in gently with a compact broadcast ripple

download-tools.label: Download Tools
download-tools.motion: arrow descends into a tray with a short spring-back

nepali-tools.label: Nepali Tools
nepali-tools.motion: subtle sunrise or calendar-page movement; avoid cliché flag-heavy treatment

text-tools.label: Text Tools
text-tools.motion: text-line reveal or cursor blink with restrained spring

pdf-tools.label: PDF Tools
pdf-tools.motion: page folds or slides into a clean document stack

audio-tools.label: Audio Tools
audio-tools.motion: waveform gently oscillates around a stable central symbol

creator-tools.label: Creator Tools
creator-tools.motion: creative sparkle orbit with a subtle camera/frame lift

productivity-tools.label: Productivity Tools
productivity-tools.motion: checkmark or task tile snaps gently into place

finance-tools.label: Finance Tools
finance-tools.motion: small chart line rises with a controlled, non-gambling visual treatment

developer-tools.label: Developer Tools
developer-tools.motion: code brackets assemble or terminal cursor slides into position

web-tools.label: Web Tools
web-tools.motion: globe/link rotates a few degrees with a soft glass reflection

utility-tools.label: Utility Tools
utility-tools.motion: compact tool glyph pops in with a subtle spring

calendar-tools.label: Calendar Tools
calendar-tools.motion: calendar page flips one step and settles

security-tools.label: Security Tools
security-tools.motion: lock closes or shield settles with a restrained protective pulse

education-tools.label: Education Tools
education-tools.motion: book opens slightly with a soft learning sparkle

social-tools.label: Social Tools
social-tools.motion: small connected nodes expand and settle

time-tools.label: Time Tools
time-tools.motion: clock hand makes a short smooth movement

generation_rules.category_resolution: Use the closest category theme. If no exact match exists, infer a new visual family from the tool purpose without copying another category literally.
avoid: copyrighted brand logos unless explicitly requested
generation_rules.reduced_motion: Return a static version with all decorative animation disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
